diagnosis: Baseline host JFR over the known 3083-state replay sampled 43,952,736,984 weighted allocation bytes. LanguageOption accounts for about 5.8%, not the leading source. CompositionPath, String and backing arrays are larger. Full path initials are concatenated at every expansion; their content is exported in Candidate and their length is also checked in correction filtering.
candidate: One change: store the existing parent path reference and this edge's existing initials string instead of eagerly concatenating all initials. Retain the exact summed length as an Int for correction filtering and materialize ordered initials iteratively only at Candidate export. Keep text, scores, beam timing, deduplication, budgets, caches and LM calls unchanged. No parameter search.
risks: Parent links could retain extra paths or negate allocation savings. Export cost could offset expansion savings. Host allocation is not Android memory or latency, so measure the actual device path too.
hostGate: Full 3083 progressive result fingerprints and LM call counts exactly equal E46. Regression tests cover mixed-length edge initials, deep chains, existing rejection of missing lexical initials, and supplementary Han; core/service/UI suites pass. Measure actual current-thread decoder allocated bytes without JFR for both fixed JARs; candidate total must be lower. Sampling evidence is diagnostic, not exact allocated bytes.
androidGate: Dedicated sense-input-quality AVD only. Learning, context, correction, explicit boundaries, association and external editor lifecycle pass. All host work finishes before one fixed E46/candidate/candidate/E46 ABBA. All 64 confirmations and 8 followups correct; sender median <=40ms and P95 <=48ms; confirmation median AND P95 each no worse than the newly sampled E46 baseline. Keep all samples, no favorable reruns.
scope: Execution cost only, not an accuracy claim. No physical phone operation. Preserve the published signed rc.6. Reject and restore production if either cost or functional gate fails. Overall quality objective remains active.
